title: Optimizing hypoglycaemia prediction in type 1 diabetes with Ensemble Machine Learning modeling.
summary: The open-access primary article evaluates an ensemble glucose model for short-term hypoglycaemia prediction in 29 people with type 1 diabetes from a prospective observational CGM study; XGBoost and SVR dominate the hypoglycaemic region under CG-EGA evaluation.
ai_technology: The ensemble ML model selects basis functions to reduce erroneous predictions in the hypoglycaemic region.
organization: Department of Biological Applications and Technology; Unit of Medical Technology Intelligent Information Systems

evidence.tested: The study reports the selected XGBoost/SVR ensemble and its short-term glucose prediction performance.
evidence.unknown: Prospective observational CGM data and continuous glucose error-grid analysis validate the bounded prediction claim.
evidence.ai_role: The ensemble ML model selects basis functions to reduce erroneous predictions in the hypoglycaemic region.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
